==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
Nito is driven off by Goh's Cinderace and instead of , as he's not with Goh in the manga.
Goh's and attempt to fight the fire are omitted.
Nito's henchmen do not appear, and he's defeated by Danika before Goh exits the mine, as opposed to after it.
Volkner is never shown telling Ash about being in the Master Class. This is only mentioned by Ash when he returns to the Cerise Laboratory.
The chapter and the manga conclude with Ash and Goh heading out on a new adventure, without giving their respective stories a conclusive ending.
